messages:
deploy-bot: Auto-promo to release/2026-06-01 paused: ci-staging failed during artifact restore: cache restore checksum mismatch for wheel. Holding promotion. https://ci.internal/runs/15222

emma: Which package and checksum?

deploy-bot: Artifact redwood-viz-0.3.1-py3-none-any.whl expected sha256=5c8f2a... got=1b4e77...
rory: tail of fetch log:
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood-viz-0.3.1.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=5c8f2a... actual=1b4e77...
storage: object truncated during read
```

infra-bot: mirror-sync job logged multipart finalize timeouts for prefix redwood-viz/0.3.1 at 07:04 UTC. Likely incomplete upload or replication glitch.

ana: change window ends in ~18m. If we wait for mirror repair we might miss the window. Options: 1) reupload mirror now and retry (uncertain time) 2) pin release to last-known-good digest and continue, then rebuild+reupload later.

emma: pin+promote sounds safer. Do we have a verified digest?
rory: found metadata: s3://prod-mirror/redwood-viz/0.3.1/sha256.txt -> 5c8f2a99. Also have archived wheel at longterm://artifacts/5c8f2a99.whl

infra-bot: If we pin, create INC-2026-199 and attach rollback steps: how to unpin and re-promote once rebuild verified. Also run a quick artifact-inspect to ensure wheel contents match the source tree hash.

emma: running dry-run pin now:
```bash
deploybot promote --release release/2026-06-01 --artifact redwood-viz==0.3.1 --digest 5c8f2a99 --force-pin --dry-run
```

emma: dry-run shows no manifest or signature mismatches. Proceeding with real promote.

deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest 5c8f2a99. Auto-promo resumed. Promotion completed.

ana: incident INC-2026-199 created, assigned to infra-blobstore. Notes: "checksum mismatch during cache restore; pinned redwood-viz 0.3.1 to last-good digest; follow-up rebuild and mirror reupload scheduled."

rory: added rollback snippet to incident: steps to unpin and re-promote if rebuilt artifact digest differs. Also queued an eval run to sanity-check runtime behavior with pinned artifact.

emma: labeling thread resolved for release. Incident remains open for RCA and uploader fix.
